name: pad_draft_extend_query
description: Scatters ragged draft-extend query rows into a padded buffer. q is [total_tokens,H,D], padded_q is [bs,max_seq_len,H,D], seq_lens_q is [bs] int32 and cu_seqlens_q is [bs+1] int32 (exclusive prefix sums). For each b and t<seq_lens_q[b], writes padded_q[b,t]=q[cu_seqlens_q[b]+t]; rows at or beyond seq_lens_q[b] are left byte-identical to their prior padded_q contents. The native operator mutates padded_q in place and returns that same storage; the reference returns a clone with the same values. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with bs 1..64, max_seq_len 4..16 and head_dim 64/128.
